about:
Hello, my name is Nguyen Tuan Ngoc. I'm an AI/ML Engineer and M.Sc. Computer Science candidate at Hochschule Darmstadt / Vietnamese-German University, focused on Computer Vision, end-to-end ML pipelines, model evaluation, and API-ready AI systems.

I have built systems across object detection (YOLOv8), multimodal RAG, FastAPI, Docker, PostgreSQL/Firebase, and reproducible experimentation. My research includes ICDAR 2025 workshop paper on Handwritten Mathematical Expression Recognition and Master's Thesis on Multimodal RAG for Leishmaniasis Diagnosis.

I am fluent in Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JavaScript/TypeScript. My field of interest includes Computer Vision, Deep Learning, RAG pipelines, and building production-ready AI systems.
